description: The biogas package is an R toolkit for processing laboratory biogas measurements and predicting methane production. Its contributors publish functions for volumetric, manometric, gravimetric and gas-density methods. Users can calculate biochemical methane potential, standardise gas volumes, predict theoretical yield from substrate composition and fit first-order production curves. Inputs are laboratory observations or chemical formulas; outputs include methane yields and kinetic parameters. Coverage is each user’s experiment and sampling period, with no built-in geographic region or temporal resolution. The public GitHub repository has source, examples and vignettes, and the package is listed for installation through CRAN. Its own DESCRIPTION declares GPL-2, so the code is free to obtain. Yield and kinetic estimates could supply parameters for anaerobic-digestion plant simulation in waste treatment or biogas supply. Laboratory substrates and conditions may differ from full-scale operations, so the package alone does not predict a facility’s actual production. No related catalogue record was identified. The package, web interface and any data were not run.
